false_success_traps: A security check has reset this form in the middle of a run. If the form comes back empty, start again from a fresh page.
After the first form, a page with no error is not a confirmation. A security check or a reloaded empty form shows no error either.
After the second form, look for clear confirmation wording. If there is none, report the request as unconfirmed.
The first form only sends a verification email. The request is not made until the second form is submitted.
When you reopen the listing later, a rate-limit page, CAPTCHA, or error page does not prove removal. Since June 2026 direct rechecks have mostly hit those pages.
genuine_confirmation: After the second form (the one reached from the email link), the page says the request was submitted or is being processed. The first form only leads to a verification email; that is not yet a removal request.
name: FastPeopleSearch

opt_out_url_check.note: A plain web request got a security challenge page (HTTP 403), not the form. A real browser may still load it.

quirks: Manual tests in many browsers and systems land on the /rate-limited page. A survey and email-capture upsell follows. No useful search results appear.
Search failures here are how the site works. They do not mean the source app module broke.
The removal flow is still useful. It asks you to confirm by email. It also has browser steps that may need CAPTCHA help.
steps: Open the removal page. A security check may appear first. A person must clear it.
Say that you are the subject of the request.
On the opt-out form, fill in your first and last name and an email address. Leave out periods, hyphens, and apostrophes in the name.
Tick the authorization box. Solve the CAPTCHA. Press Submit.
Wait for an email from FastPeopleSearch. Check the spam folder too.
Open the link in that email. It leads to a second, longer form.
The second form may arrive filled with broken text. Clear every field and type the values again.
Fill in name, street address, city, state, ZIP code, phone number, and email. Date of birth is optional.
Tick the authorization box. Solve the second CAPTCHA. Press Submit.
The broker quotes up to 72 hours. Check the listing again after that.
playbook.suppression_lane: Run the FastPeopleSearch removal flow right away. Do not wait for scan evidence first.
